description:
Brophy Estates are delighted to present 46 Parkview, Robswall to the market. This impressive three-bedroom duplex is ideally located within the highly regarded Robswall development in Malahide.

This spacious, double-fronted home offers beautifully proportioned accommodation over two floors, with an abundance of natural light, spectacular coastal views and a well-designed layout that combines comfortable family living with excellent entertaining space.

Upon entering, the generous entrance hallway immediately creates a welcoming sense of space and provides access to the principal accommodation. The bright and well-appointed kitchen and breakfast area features two large windows, creating a light and pleasant space throughout the day. An additional office/study is conveniently positioned off the hallway, making it ideal for those working from home or requiring a versatile additional room.

To the rear, the superb open-plan living and dining room provides an expansive and versatile space for both relaxing and entertaining. Large windows flood the room with natural light while showcasing stunning views towards the coast and Lambay Island, creating a wonderful connection with the surrounding landscape.

Upstairs, there are three excellent-sized bedrooms, all benefiting from fitted wardrobes. The impressive master bedroom is a particular highlight, enjoying spectacular coastal views and access to two balconies, one east-facing and one west-facing. This unique feature ensures the room is filled with natural light throughout the day, while providing wonderful outdoor spaces from which to enjoy the ever-changing coastal outlook. The generous proportions of the master bedroom also allow it to be utilised as a versatile second living room, if desired.

Coastal Living with Spectacular Views

Robswall enjoys an enviable position just off Malahide's scenic Coast Road, combining a peaceful coastal setting with superb convenience. The development benefits from a wonderful seaside atmosphere, with stunning views towards the coast and Lambay Island adding to the appeal of this exceptional location.

Malahide Village is within easy reach and offers an excellent selection of cafés, restaurants, bars, boutiques and everyday amenities. The beautiful seafront provides a picturesque coastal walk towards Portmarnock's sandy beach, while Paddy's Hill offers a pleasant route to the gates of Malahide Castle and Gardens.

With its generous accommodation, exceptional natural light, spectacular coastal and Lambay Island views, and the rare benefit of two private balconies, 46 Parkview presents an outstanding opportunity for those seeking a quality home in one of Malahide's most desirable residential settings.

2 allocated parking spaces.

Management fee approx. €1,555.00.

Early viewing is highly recommended.
